integrity: Exact integer modular residue enumeration with a deterministic prime sieve and independent modular computation of the six roots; source programs provided.
scientific_limitations: Proves a finite exact least prime and six root classes for multiplicity at least six only. Does not resolve unbounded lambda(p), higher p-power valuations, or all possible literature priority. No independent audit performed.
title: The first Schenker prime with six nonzero zero-classes
